**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The APCN 2 consortium agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement restriction on Teleglobe USA Inc. Searches across the full document for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "employ or engage", "hire", "employees", "personnel" and "staff" returned nothing, and the only clauses that could carry such a covenant do not: § 21.1 (Relationship of Parties) confines the common enterprise to the Agreement's express provisions, and § 31 (Confidentiality) restricts only disclosure of data and information, not engagement of another Party's personnel. Since our preferred position is simply that no non-solicit binds the Customer, this sits at preferred and no redline was proposed.
